headline: Meta launches Tamagotchi-style AI pet app called Waddle World
summary: Meta has launched Waddle World, a Tamagotchi-style AI pet app in which virtual creatures chat with users. Meta describes the app, listed as a pet care game, as a daily journal disguised as a pet rather than a conventional game.

claims.statement: Meta launched a new app called Waddle World, a Tamagotchi-style AI pet.

sources.quote: Meta's Waddle World is a Tamagotchi-like AI pet app
which essentially looks like a Tamagotchi clone, but with AI

claims.statement: Meta's own description frames the app as a daily journal disguised as a pet, not really a game.
